words.zh: 漂亮的， 娇小可爱的； 聪明的， 伶俐的

words.ex_zh: 一只逗人爱的小狗

words.ex_en: This gives the company a competitive advantage over its rivals.
words.ex_zh: 这使该公司与其对手相比具有一项竞争优势。

words.zh: 大头针，别针，针；栓；琐碎物
words.ex_en: They pinned a notice to the door.
words.ex_zh: 他们把通知钉在门上。

words.ex_en: ‘I don’t think it’s right,’ John persisted.
words.ex_zh: “我认为那不对。”约翰坚持说道。

words.ex_en: He strode across the bathroom, shedding wet clothes as he went.
words.ex_zh: 他大步走过浴室，边走边把湿衣服脱下来。

words.ex_en: The bishop helped foster the sense of a community embracing all classes.
words.ex_zh: 主教鼓励一种包容各个阶层的社区精神。

words.ex_en: Well what about your bicycle?
words.ex_zh: 那么你的自行车呢？

words.ex_en: The water in the tank is constantly filtered.
words.ex_zh: 鱼缸里的水在不停地被过滤。

words.ex_en: a preacher who claims that he can heal the sick
words.ex_zh: 自称可以治病的传道士

words.ex_en: Andy has a fever and won’t be coming into work today.
words.ex_zh: 安迪发烧了，今天不来上班。

words.ex_en: Homeworkers can easily be exploited by employers.
words.ex_zh: 在家工作的人容易被雇主剥削。

words.ex_en: All living organisms have to adapt to changes in environmental conditions.
words.ex_zh: 一切生物都要适应环境条件的变化。

words.ex_en: The word ‘aromatherapy’ was coined in the 1920s. aromatherapy
words.ex_zh: （芳香疗法）这个词是在20世纪20年代创造出来的。

words.zh: 易接近的；可进入的；可理解的
words.ex_en: The island is only accessible by boat.
words.ex_zh: 这个岛只有坐船才能到。

words.ex_en: We chartered a boat to take us to some of the smaller islands.
words.ex_zh: 我们包了一条船带我们到一些较小的岛上去。

words.ex_en: He finally consented to go.
words.ex_zh: 他最终同意去。

words.ex_en: They built a dam along the seashore to retain the seawater.
words.ex_zh: 他们沿海岸筑起一道堤坝以拦住海水。

words.zh: 全套服装； 一组人； 全套装备， 全套工具
words.ex_en: She bought a new outfit for the party.
words.ex_zh: 她为了这次派对买了套新衣服。

words.ex_en: the preliminary stages of the competition
words.ex_zh: 竞赛的预赛阶段

words.zh: 授予专利；取得…的专利权
words.ex_en: He patented the idea that the atom could be split.
words.ex_zh: 他得到了原子可以分裂的这个见解的专利。
